scripts.tauri:dev: npm run build:helper:dev && npm run gen:types && tauri dev
scripts.build:helper: cd helper && cargo build --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin && cargo build --release --target x86_64-apple-darwin && mkdir -p ../src-tauri/resources/helper && lipo -create -output ../src-tauri/resources/helper/l2tp-hub-helper target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/l2tp-hub-helper target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release/l2tp-hub-helper && cp com.sentiago.l2tp-hub.helper.plist ../src-tauri/resources/helper/
scripts.build:guardian: cd route-guardian && cargo build --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin && cargo build --release --target x86_64-apple-darwin && mkdir -p ../src-tauri/resources/guardian && lipo -create -output ../src-tauri/resources/guardian/l2tp-hub-guardian target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/l2tp-hub-guardian target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release/l2tp-hub-guardian && cp com.sentiago.l2tp-hub.guardian.plist ../src-tauri/resources/guardian/
scripts.build:all: npm run build:helper && npm run build:guardian && bash ./build.sh && npm run gen:types && tsc && vite build && tauri build
